caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container, most likely a jar or canister, shown in an upright position. The container features two horizontal bands near the top, giving the impression of a lid or reinforced rim. Centered on the front surface of the jar, there is an inscribed rectangular panel containing stylized text and symbols: a large "E C" with a star and another small symbol between them. Below this, the numbers "1799" are written, and beneath that is "No 2" in ornate script, with a small "99" adjacent to the "2". The lines of the drawing are delicate and monochromatic, rendered in a single shade of gray on a plain, light background. The illustration is executed with thin, precise linework and no shading or color filling.
title: Jar
